Section 2 'Anti-patterns to reject' lists: (a) tests that only assert response.status_code == 200 without checking body (equivalent to toBeDefined), (b) tests that compute expected values the same way the code does (implementation-mirroring), (c) not explicitly mentioned but snapshot abuse is implicitly excluded by requiring explicit assertions, (d) vague test names addressed with naming pattern and bad examples, (e) mocking the function under test instead of its dependencies. 4 of 5 explicitly addressed; (c) snapshot abuse not explicitly mentioned. Passing as 3+ are clearly addressed.
